b1-09-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Do You Feel?
b1-09-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos comes home from the office and asks how you are. You have felt dizzy since this morning, but you felt worse yesterday.
b1-09-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how you feel today and how you felt yesterday.
b1-09-01.target: Me siento mareada desde esta mañana, aunque ayer me sentía peor.
b1-09-01.english: I have felt dizzy since this morning, although yesterday I felt worse.
b1-09-01.canDo: I can describe physical and emotional states with estar and sentirse.

b1-09-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Advice for a Tired Friend
b1-09-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg has felt exhausted for three days. You want to help her.
b1-09-02.prompt: Advise Meg to rest and to make a doctor's appointment.
cues: Recommend that she makes an appointment
b1-09-02.target: Te recomiendo que descanses unos días y que pidas una consulta.
b1-09-02.english: I recommend that you rest for a few days and make an appointment.
b1-09-02.canDo: I can give health advice using the present subjunctive.

b1-09-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Healthy Habits
b1-09-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you do to sleep better after long days at the office. You walk after dinner and keep your phone away before bed.
b1-09-03.prompt: Tell Meg what you usually do and why.
cues: Say what you usually do after dinner
Say what you avoid before bed
b1-09-03.target: Suelo caminar después de cenar y evito el teléfono antes de acostarme, porque así duermo mejor.
b1-09-03.english: I usually walk after dinner and avoid the phone before going to bed, because that way I sleep better.
b1-09-03.canDo: I can describe regular health habits and routines.

b1-09-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Notice at the Clinic
b1-09-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what the clinic near your flat in Budapest offers. You have read the notice on the door.
b1-09-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what is offered and what the notice recommends.
cues: Say what is offered on Fridays
b1-09-04.target: En esta clínica se ofrecen consultas gratuitas los viernes y se recomienda dormir bien.
b1-09-04.english: Free consultations are offered at this clinic on Fridays and it is recommended to sleep well.
b1-09-04.canDo: I can give general health information without naming an agent.

b1-09-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Gregor's Story
b1-09-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have read the story of Gregor, who wakes up one morning as an insect. Tell Carlos what happened and what you think about it.
b1-09-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Gregor found out and give your advice.
cues: Give advice and explain why it matters
b1-09-05.target: Una mañana, Gregor descubrió que ya no era una persona. Es importante que una persona descanse, y él nunca había tenido tiempo para hacerlo.
b1-09-05.english: One morning, Gregor found out that he was no longer a person. It is important that a person rests, and he had never had time to do it.
b1-09-05.canDo: I can give connected health advice and explain why it matters.

b1-09-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Asking for Advice
b1-09-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You feel exhausted and you usually sleep little. You ask Meg for advice.
b1-09-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg how you feel, what you usually do, and ask what she recommends.
b1-09-consolidation.target: Me siento agotado y suelo dormir poco. ¿Qué me recomiendas que haga?
b1-09-consolidation.english: I feel exhausted and I usually sleep little. What do you recommend that I do?
b1-09-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate health and wellbeing language.
